label: QA lane
description: Tells cckit how THIS project's review stack boots, so a wave can be reviewed on one running stack. cckit asks and records; it never boots the project by guessing and never writes a boot script.
title: QA lane — how this project boots
intro: Five answers, saved under `qa` in this project's kit config. Credentials are recorded by env var NAME only: a value is refused, never written.

questions.question: Which command boots the whole review stack (every service a reviewer needs)? e.g. `pnpm dev:stack`
Which port env vars does that command honour, and what is each one's base port? Comma-separated NAME=port, e.g. `WEB_PORT=3000, API_PORT=4000`. A name with no port gets the next free base from 3000.
Which path answers once each service is usable? Comma-separated PORT_VAR=path, one probe per service, e.g. `WEB_PORT=/, API_PORT=/health`. A name with no path probes `/`.
Which route should a reviewer land on when the work declares none? e.g. `/dashboard`
Which env vars hold the test account's credentials? NAMES only, comma-separated, e.g. `QA_EMAIL, QA_PASSWORD`. Never type a value here.
